profile_text.body:
Salesforce is a public company, traded as CRM, founded in 1999 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. Its most recent 10-K reported revenue of $41,525,000,000 for the period ending 2026-01-31. The material harvested from its site is Slack's AI features page, which describes AI in Slack as a way to summarize channels and threads, search files, take meeting notes, translate conversations, and build automations, with daily recaps and a Slackbot described as a personal AI agent that adapts to a user's tone and style.

The company's tracked AI products are Slack AI, Tableau AI (Einstein) for natural language queries over business intelligence data with CRM integration and Trust Layer governance, and Salesforce Einstein / Agentforce for CRM-embedded AI and agents. The site says Slack is the conversational UI for Agentforce, and that agents built with Agentforce can run in Slack channels, threads, and DMs to query data and trigger actions. It states that customer data is not used to train large language models, that LLM providers do not have access to customer data, and that the models are hosted within Slack's AWS virtual private cloud. AI features are described as available across all paid Slack plans.

Six MCP servers are listed under the company's name, including ai.cirra/salesforce-mcp for administration and management, several ai.smithery/kodey-ai-salesforce-mcp variants that run SOQL queries to retrieve records, fields, and relationships, and cloud.serpent/salesforce-devops for planning deploys, opening pull requests, and triggering pipelines. Legal exposure is recorded in California, with a count of 281.
